summary: Scalar-deleting destructor pattern for an unknown object. Invokes the helper sub_485EB0 (0x00485EB0) unconditionally on this, then, when the deleting flag a2 has bit 0 set, releases the object allocation via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF). Returns this unchanged, matching the MSVC scalar-deleting-destructor calling convention.

local_names.this: object being torn down; returned unchanged
local_names.a2: deleting flag; bit 0 selects the memory-free path

operations.description: Call sub_485EB0 (0x00485EB0) unconditionally with this as the __thiscall receiver; its role as the destructor body is not evidenced by this packet
Guard on the deleting flag a2: when (a2 & 1) != 0 the object memory is freed; otherwise this is returned without freeing
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) with this to release the object allocation when the deleting flag is set
Return this, keeping the object pointer valid as required by the scalar-deleting destructor convention
